combatants.png.prompt: Edit target image 1 (the 4x6 sprite atlas) using image 2 ONLY as visual style reference. Preserve EXACT atlas structure: 1024x1536 transparent PNG, 4 columns by 6 rows, 256x256 cells, feet same baseline in every cell, each figure entirely inside its cell. Replace the characters' rendering with the cheerful CHIBI fantasy design of the reference: large expressive heads, about 2.3-head-tall proportions, friendly strong dark outlines, warm light palette, simple clean shaded shapes, readable at small size. This is a 2D handheld RPG sprite atlas with crisp deliberate edges and small pixel-friendly details, not realistic tall figures. ROW 1: front view warrior, brown tousled hair, red scarf/cape, steel armor, sword and shield, faces down-left; ROW 2: matching warrior from the back facing up-right; ROW 3: front view mage with purple pointed hat and purple robe, dark violet hair, glowing violet orb staff, faces down-left; ROW 4: matching mage back facing up-right; ROW 5: front view forest archer in green hood/tunic with wooden bow, faces down-left; ROW 6 matching archer back facing up-right. COLUMNS in all rows: idle; alternate idle/breathing pose; attack pose appropriate to class; receiving-hit pose. Maintain consistent outfits and identity across poses and paired front/back rows. Warrior front sword slash goes left, mage front spell goes left, archer front draws/releases arrow left; back-view attacks go right. NO cleric, no slime, no creatures, no reference UI or lettering. No opaque backdrop, no gray plate, no cell outlines, no words, no large glows spilling into adjacent cells. Preserve genuinely transparent alpha outside each figure. Ref image 2 contributes only style and class designs.
combatants.png.layout: 4 columns x 6 rows, idle/alternate-idle/attack/hurt; warrior front/back, mage front/back, archer front/back
